name: Coos Bay
seo_title: Coos Bay OR Christmas Events for Kids 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Coos Bay, Oregon for 2026: tree lightings with Santa, railway museum lights, Shore Acres, Christmas on Main and an Opry.
lede: Coos Bay and North Bend share one big season, from Santa leading a lighted walk to the tree on November 28 to the railway museum's 100,000 lights, Shore Acres, Christmas on Main in North Bend and a family Opry.
celebrates: Oregon's Adventure Coast, the regional tourism group for Coos Bay, North Bend, Empire and Charleston, lists a full holiday schedule, and the Umpqua towns of Reedsport and Winchester Bay add a tree lighting and a Santa festival. The Coos Bay Downtown Association starts it on November 28 with Santa, a Walking Lighted Parade and the Coos Bay Tree Lighting at the Visitor Center. Empire follows on December 4 with caroling, a costume pet parade and Santa, and North Bend's Christmas on Main on December 5 adds waffles with Santa, free skating and a lighted truck parade.
lastyear: The City of Coos Bay's December 2025 holiday post shows what families did last year. It listed Shop Small Saturday on November 29 with a Nog and Cider Walk, a Santa meet and greet at the Visitor Center, a new Walking Light Parade at 5 pm and the Christmas Tree Lighting at 5:30 pm. Empire held its tree lighting at the Star of Hope on December 5, and Santa's Shuttle ran free evening rides from the Charleston Marina lot to Shore Acres.
facts: Shore Acres State Park says its show has more than 325,000 LED lights and 26 Christmas trees, and timed entry plus $10 parking must be bought before arrival. North Bend's rink is the only ice rink on the Oregon coast, with 3,250 square feet of synthetic ice inside a 5,000 square foot tent. Skate rentals are $5, and skaters under 14 need a guardian present.
trains: Coos Bay's train moment is the Oregon Coast Historic Railway Museum Holiday Lights, from November 26, 2026 through January 1, 2027. Vintage railroad engines, cabooses and other equipment are covered in 100,000 lights and ornaments in downtown Coos Bay, on from dusk until 11 pm. Oregon's Adventure Coast says it is always free, and children can look for stuffed animals in the train windows.
traditions: Santa leads a Walking Lighted Parade to the Visitor Center and lights the tree at 5:45 pm on November 28.
Engines and cabooses in 100,000 lights, free to view, November 26 to January 1.
325,000 LED lights in the garden, with timed $10 parking, November 26 to December 31.
North Bend's December 5 day of waffles with Santa, free skating, a block party and a lighted truck parade.
Caroling, Santa and a costume pet parade at Ed Lund Park on December 4.
Santa arrives by Coast Guard boat at Winchester Bay on December 5, with cocoa, cookies and crafts.
kidfact: North Bend's ice rink is the only one on the Oregon coast, and its synthetic ice sits inside a 5,000 square foot tent.
faq: How does Coos Bay celebrate Christmas?

Coos Bay holds its tree lighting with Santa and a Walking Lighted Parade on November 28, and the region adds Empire's tree lighting on December 4, North Bend's Christmas on Main on December 5, the railway museum lights and Shore Acres.
When is the Coos Bay tree lighting?
Santa lights the tree at 5:45 pm on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at the Coos Bay Visitor Center, 50 Central Ave, after a lighted walk with Santa and cookies and cider from 5 pm.
Are the Coos Bay railway museum lights free?
Yes. Oregon's Adventure Coast says the display is always free and can be viewed from your vehicle or the sidewalk, from dusk until 11 pm through January 1.
Do I need a reservation for Shore Acres Holiday Lights?
Yes. Oregon State Parks says timed entry and $10 parking must be bought before arrival, with slots at 4:30, 5:30, 6:30 and 7:30 pm.
Where are the North Bend and Charleston events?

This page includes North Bend's Christmas on Main and Christmas Opry, Shore Acres in Charleston, Empire's tree lighting, and Reedsport, Winchester Bay and Gardiner events from the Umpqua area to the north.

The magic runs from November 26 (Holiday Lights at Shore Acres State Park) through January 1, with Coos Bay Tree Lighting with Santa and Walking Lighted Parade (November 28), Reedsport Holiday Tree Lighting (November 28) and The Muppet Christmas Carol Movie Night (December 2) along the way. We check every date on the host’s own website, and each listing links straight there. For the whole area, see Christmas events for kids in Eugene. For the rest of the state, see our Oregon Christmas events for kids guide.
